summary: A view is a saved SELECT with a name. You query it like a table, which hides a long join behind a short name.
notes: A view stores the query, not the data. Every SELECT from roster reads the current tables.
Name columns with AS inside the view (c.name AS course) so the view has clear column names.
Remove a view with DROP VIEW roster. The tables it reads are not affected.
pitfall: In SQLite, views are read-only. INSERT INTO roster ... gives Parse error: cannot modify roster because it is a view. Change the underlying tables instead.
